messages:
alex: Bringing up halcyon-lite-13b (hybrid int6) in canary. Seeing p99 OOM spikes when batch > 4 or max_new_tokens > 200 — any quick triage ideas?

maya: I see repeated CUDA OOMs and lots of small free/alloc churn in the logs — looks like fragmentation rather than steady leak. Paste of latest:```
E CudaOOM: out of memory when allocating 1.2GiB
2026-03-22T12:03:44Z halcyon-worker-7 kernel: free 24MiB, alloc 1.2GiB, largest_free 28MiB
... eviction failed: no reclaimable slots (kv_cache_active=0.78)
```

chris: Ran quick perf matrix on the canary infra (same prompts, 50-shot) — numbers:```
mode     | batch | max_new | p50_lat ms | p95_lat ms | mem_peak GiB
fp16     | 4     | 256     | 110        | 240        | 12.4
int8     | 4     | 256     | 95         | 210        | 9.8
int6     | 4     | 256     | 88         | 260 (spike) | 8.9
int6     | 2     | 128     | 92         | 180        | 7.6
```
Int6 has lower steady mem but big p95 spikes + fragmentation -> OOMs.

emma: Quality note from eval harness: int6 shows ~1.8% BLEU drop on long-context summarization and higher hallucination rate on closed-book QA vs fp16. Not huge but noticeable on downstream metrics.

raj: Hypothesis: prefetch + large max_new_tokens keeps longer KV chains in memory causing allocation scatter once new requests arrive. Two quick mitigations: lower model default max_new_tokens to 128 for halcyon-lite, and enable kv_trim_on_evict + soft_reserve (0.12). Also consider disabling prefetch for this model during canary.

alex: I'll prepare a model-config change: batch_limit=4, default_max_new_tokens=128, slot_reserve=0.12, prefetch=false. Plan: canary 5% traffic, observe p95/p99 and gpu_mem_frag_ratio. @deploy-bot can you schedule a config rollout?

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for halcyon-lite-13b at 2026-03-22T12:10:00Z to 5% traffic. :white_check_mark:

maya: Also recommend starting canary with int8 quant instead of int6 to avoid quality regression while we sort frag. Command to flip locally:```
redwoodctl model update halcyon-lite-13b --quant-mode int8 --defaults max_new_tokens=128 --prefetch=false --slot-reserve=0.12 --canary 0.05
redwoodctl eval run --suite=regression,qa,summary --samples=1000 --out=canary-int8-results.json
```

chris: If int8 passes (no OOMs, <0.5% quality delta), we can re-run int6 with kernel-scheduler tweak (batch_affinity=true) and enable soft kv-evict heuristics. I'll add a metric watch on gpu_mem_frag_ratio, kv_cache_active, evict_fail_count.

emma: Sounds good. I'll own quality gates: if any eval shows >1% degradation or QA F1 drop > 0.03 we'll abort canary and revert quant change.

alex: Thanks — will push config and ping once deploy starts. We'll reconvene in 30m after first 5% window.
